## IRenderMode type

Send-versus-edit resolution for a render call.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IRenderMode = `auto` | `reply` | `edit`;
```

## Remarks

- `auto` (default): edits when the update carries a `callbackQuery`<!-- -->,  otherwise replies. - `reply`<!-- -->: always sends a new message. - `edit`<!-- -->: always edits the message tied to the update.
